notablePrerequisites: You control at least five other creatures.
description:
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it and sacrificing five other creatures.
When the creatures die as Clerics due to Maskwood Nexus, Rotlung Reanimator triggers five times, creating five 2/2 Zombie creature tokens.
Resolve the Time Sieve ability, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.
